title_zh: RADIUS協議CVE -2024-3596
summary_en: A fundamental design flaw within the RADIUS protocol has been proven to be exploitable, compromising the integrity in the RADIUS Access-Request process. The attack allows a malicious user to modify packets in a way that would be indistinguishable to a RADIUS client or server. To be successful, the attacker must have the ability to inject themselves between the client and server. Revised on 2025-07-10 00:00:00
summary_zh: RADIUS協議中的一個基本設計缺陷已被證明是可利用的，這會損害RADIUS訪問過程中的完整性。該攻擊允許惡意用戶以RADIUS客戶端或服務器無法區分的方式修改數據包。為了取得成功，攻擊者必須能夠在客戶端和服務器之間注入自己。修訂於2025-07-10 00:00:00

title_en: Pre-authentication Denial of Service attack in OpenSSH - CVE-2025-26466
title_zh: 在Openssh進行預授權拒絕服務攻擊 -  CVE -2025-26466
summary_en: CVE-2025-26466A flaw was found in the OpenSSH package. For each ping packet the SSH server receives, a pong packet is allocated in a memory buffer and stored in a queue of packages. It is only freed when the server/client key exchange has finished. A malicious client may keep sending such packages, leading to an uncontrolled increase in memory consumption on the server side. Consequently, the server may become unavailable, resulting in a denial of service attack. Revised on 2025-07-30 00:00:00
summary_zh: CVE -2025-26466a在OpenSSH軟件包中發現了缺陷。對於SSH服務器都會收到的每個Ping數據包，將乒乓數據包分配在存儲器緩衝區中，並存儲在包裝中。只有在服務器/客戶端密鑰交換完成後才釋放。惡意客戶端可能會繼續發送此類軟件包，從而導致服務器端的內存消耗不受控制。因此，服務器可能無法使用，導致拒絕服務攻擊。修訂於2025-07-30 00:00:00
